text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired -> PD-92431 'embeddings-queue error spike' (eu-west1). Auto-escalation to #eng-oncall. Affected service: embedder-worker. Severity: P1.
Jordan: acked via PagerDuty, jumping on logs now.
Jordan: seeing spike of 500s from embedder pods, backlog growing ~1.2k reqs.
Jordan: quick check: `kubectl -n inference get pods | grep embedder`
Ryan: taking bridge. joining huddle in 30s.
Jordan: throttling batch-size from 64 -> 8 for embedder config to reduce OOMs. Applying now: `kubectl set env deploy/embedder BATCH_SIZE=8` (will monitor)
Maria: customer impact: two large customers seeing 5-10s tail latency, some timeouts. Notifying CS.
Sam: logs indicate `oomkilled` on embedder-2, GPU memory pressure high.
Ryan: can we fallback to quantized variant? route policy 'fallback-quant' available.
Jordan: enabling fallback route for new requests, adding temporary rate-limit: `redwoodctl routes update embedder --fallback quantized --rate 200r/s`
incident-bot: PD note: escalation -> oncall claimed by Jordan then transferred to Ryan at 3181234620.
Ryan: rdy. Jordan handing off — full context in thread, watch for regressions.
Jordan: leaving bridge, monitoring post-change metrics for 10m. :thumbsup:
Maria: CS ping sent to impacted customers, ETA to resolution TBD. Will escalate if SLA likely missed.
Sam: mitigation holding, error rate dropping to ~3% from 12% in last 2m.
Ryan: will keep bridge open for 15 more minutes, then handback. If error >5% we open major incident.
incident-bot: note added to PD incident PD-92431: 'fallback to quantized variant + reduced batch-size applied, observing metrics'.
